author: (Mörch, 1877)

note.en: A tiny false limpet with a flat, cap-shaped shell, known here from three specimens taken at 23 to 29 m off Manzanillo in 2001 and 2003. No size was found, so the size shown is a rough estimate.
note.es: Una falsa lapa diminuta con concha plana en forma de gorro, conocida aquí por tres ejemplares tomados a 23 y 29 m frente a Manzanillo en 2001 y 2003. No se halló su talla, así que la talla indicada es una estimación aproximada.

evidence: GBIF: 3 preserved specimens in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001 and 2003)
SeaLifeBase: 0 to 101 m, found on offshore banks

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
